overview_description.description:
Chartio is on a mission to democratize data so that everyone has the freedom to explore, transform, and visualize their data. Chartio has built a simple, yet intuitive cloud-based data exploration solution that makes it easy to connect all of your data to create powerful dashboards, without any SQL knowledge. 

With a drag and drop user interface and powerful data pipeline, Chartio helps businesses intuitively query, analyze and track key metrics in real-time to quickly identify trends, patterns, and outliers. 

Chartio was co-founded by Dave Fowler and Daniel Levine in June 2010 and is based in San Francisco, California.
